_comment: Missives for the Bad Guys (the sister mod of Missives for the Good Guys, by Lizzy of the Wildlander Team; taken in with its author's permission): its missives with the Guild rank of the list SkyPatcher puts each in (Low E, Med D, High C, ExtraHigh B), generated by tools/EspGen from its plugin and MFTBG_Formlists.ini (see MissivesPatch.BadGuys). boardContainers: its Outlaw Refuge boards. Read only when MissivesForTheBadGuys.esp is loaded; nothing of it is mastered, copied or shipped. The editor IDs are for reading only.
